title: Raiju thunder beast of Japanese folklore

tellings.quote: character in Japanese folklore known as the Rayu, which is a thunder beast that becomes activated during thunderstorms.

plain: Japanese folklore has a creature called the Raiju, a thunder beast that comes alive during thunderstorms, according to Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says an alien told him the true purpose of the pyramids. Drumm brings up the legend while talking with Michels, from his own knowledge and without naming a source, as part of his talk about storms and energy.
